# PRI Global

> PRI Global is a US-based IT staffing and technology services company founded in 1997, headquartered in Ellisville, Missouri, with delivery centers in the USA, India, the Philippines, and Canada. It provides IT staffing and talent solutions, managed IT services, and AI innovation through its PR1SM.AI platform and PRI AI Pods™. 28+ years in business, 12,700+ placements.

Key facts:
- Founded: 1997 (28+ years of operation)
- Headquarters: 174 Clarkson Road, Ellisville, MO 63011, USA
- Locations: USA, India, Philippines, Canada
- Contact: info@priglobal.com, +1 636.256.7172
- Core services: IT staffing & talent solutions, managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud, data engineering, AI services (PR1SM.AI, PRI AI Pods™)
- Industries served: financial services, healthcare, pharmaceutical, retail, government, technology
